staleness_rules: a record with a different task commit is stale for the selected task snapshot
a record with a different control-plane commit is stale for the selected control-plane snapshot
a downstream record whose ledger event predates the latest selected current executable predecessor event is stale even when commits are unchanged
a stale, missing or blocked upstream node makes every later historical record stale by dependency propagation
an explicitly invalidated evidence reference makes the record that cites it stale
a content-hash mismatch for an explicitly refreshed evidence reference makes the citing record stale
a non-current FROZEN_CANDIDATE state prevents QUALITY_INTERLOCK and all later nodes from being current
an external-gate DISPATCHED record remains pending until a later current completion record for the same stage and task snapshot is recorded
